name: BH Related Post
author: ThemesVila

sections.description:
BH Related Post is a simple yet powerful plugin that displays related posts using a jCarousel slider. It helps keep users engaged by showcasing other relevant content from the same category, right after or before your post content or comment section.

Built using jQuery and the jCarousel plugin, it is lightweight and compatible across all modern browsers.

Features

  • Responsive jCarousel slider
  • Show posts from the same category
  • Cross-browser compatible
  • Lightweight and fast
  • Display positions: after content, before comments, after comments, or hidden
  • Admin settings page to control display behavior
  • Easy to use – just activate and configure
sections.installation:
1. Upload the bh-related-post folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure settings via BH Related Post in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. (Optional) Use <?php bh_related_post(); ?> in your theme templates for manual placement.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin compatible with all browsers?

Yes, it supports all modern browsers including Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Safari, and Opera.

Can I control where the related posts appear?

Yes, from the plugin settings you can choose to display after content, before comments, after comments, or hide it completely.
